package domain

import (
	"errors"
	"testing"
	"time"
)

// This fixture mirrors Planner's wire fields and explicit digest projection.
// In particular created_at is deliberately excluded from the digest.
func TestDiagnosticPlanDigestMatchesPlannerCanonicalProjection(t *testing.T) {
	plan := DiagnosticAssessmentPlan{Schema: DiagnosticAssessmentPlanSchema, ID: "11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111", StudentID: "22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222", CourseID: "33333333-3333-4333-8333-333333333333", PlanRevision: 1, PolicyVersion: DiagnosticAssessmentPolicy, OnboardingVersion: 1, BootstrapPolicyVersion: DiagnosticBootstrapPolicy, BootstrapContextDigest: "sha256:cccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccc", CourseContentRevision: "sha256:aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa", CreatedAt: time.Date(2026, 1, 1, 0, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC), Assessments: []DiagnosticAssessmentPlanItem{{LessonID: "44444444-4444-4444-8444-444444444444", TaskID: "55555555-5555-4555-8555-555555555555", TaskVersion: 1, UpdatedAt: time.Date(2026, 1, 2, 0, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC), LessonOrder: 1, TaskOrder: 2, LearningTargets: []LearningTargetRef{{Type: "concept", Key: "go.syntax", Version: "v1"}}}}}
	digest, err := DiagnosticAssessmentPlanDigest(plan)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	const want = "sha256:557a690eb6a6455adbd65bccd3b60c0e792a702ad3cea67c218583b3a045ff8d"
	if digest != want {
		t.Fatalf("digest=%s", digest)
	}
	changed := plan
	changed.CreatedAt = plan.CreatedAt.Add(time.Hour)
	other, _ := DiagnosticAssessmentPlanDigest(changed)
	if other != digest {
		t.Fatal("created_at must not change Planner-compatible digest")
	}
}

func TestDiagnosticTargetsUsePlannerParity(t *testing.T) {
	result, err := NormalizeDiagnosticLearningTargets([]LearningTargetRef{{Type: LearningTargetConcept, Key: "GO.Syntax", Version: "V1"}})
	if err != nil || result[0].Key != "go.syntax" || result[0].Version != "v1" {
		t.Fatalf("normalized=%#v err=%v", result, err)
	}
	for _, target := range []LearningTargetRef{{Type: LearningTargetConcept, Key: "go.syntax", Version: ""}, {Type: LearningTargetConcept, Key: "GO Syntax", Version: "v1"}} {
		if _, err := NormalizeDiagnosticLearningTargets([]LearningTargetRef{target}); err == nil {
			t.Fatalf("expected invalid target %#v", target)
		}
	}
}

func diagnosticTestPlan(t *testing.T, count int) DiagnosticAssessmentPlan {
	t.Helper()
	plan := DiagnosticAssessmentPlan{
		Schema: DiagnosticAssessmentPlanSchema, ID: "11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111",
		StudentID: "22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222", CourseID: "33333333-3333-4333-8333-333333333333",
		PlanRevision: 2, PolicyVersion: DiagnosticAssessmentPolicy,
		OnboardingVersion: 1, BootstrapPolicyVersion: DiagnosticBootstrapPolicy,
		BootstrapContextDigest: "sha256:cccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccc",
		CourseContentRevision:  "sha256:aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa",
		CreatedAt:              time.Date(2026, 1, 1, 0, 0, 0, 123456000, time.UTC),
	}
	for i := 0; i < count; i++ {
		plan.Assessments = append(plan.Assessments, DiagnosticAssessmentPlanItem{
			LessonID: "44444444-4444-4444-8444-444444444444", TaskID: string(rune('5'+i)) + "5555555-5555-4555-8555-555555555555",
			TaskVersion: int64(i + 1), UpdatedAt: time.Date(2026, 1, 2+i, 0, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC), LessonOrder: i, TaskOrder: i,
			LearningTargets: []LearningTargetRef{{Type: LearningTargetConcept, Key: "go.syntax", Version: "v1"}, {Type: LearningTargetCapability, Key: "go.compile", Version: "v1"}},
		})
	}
	// Keep the fixture's task UUIDs canonical while still distinct.
	for i := range plan.Assessments {
		plan.Assessments[i].TaskID = "55555555-5555-4555-8555-55555555555" + string(rune('0'+i))
	}
	digest, err := DiagnosticAssessmentPlanDigest(plan)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	plan.PlanDigest = digest
	return plan
}

func TestDiagnosticPlanRequiresThreeToFiveItemsAndFrozenParity(t *testing.T) {
	for _, count := range []int{3, 4, 5} {
		if _, err := NormalizeDiagnosticAssessmentPlan(diagnosticTestPlan(t, count)); err != nil {
			t.Fatalf("count=%d: %v", count, err)
		}
	}
	for _, count := range []int{0, 1, 2, 6} {
		plan := diagnosticTestPlan(t, count)
		if _, err := NormalizeDiagnosticAssessmentPlan(plan); !errors.Is(err, ErrValidation) {
			t.Fatalf("count=%d expected validation, got %v", count, err)
		}
	}
	duplicate := diagnosticTestPlan(t, 3)
	duplicate.Assessments[1].TaskID = duplicate.Assessments[0].TaskID
	if _, err := NormalizeDiagnosticAssessmentPlan(duplicate); !errors.Is(err, ErrValidation) {
		t.Fatalf("duplicate task accepted: %v", err)
	}
	duplicate = diagnosticTestPlan(t, 3)
	duplicate.Assessments[1].LearningTargets[0] = duplicate.Assessments[0].LearningTargets[0]
	// Target duplication is rejected within one task, not across frozen tasks.
	duplicate.Assessments[0].LearningTargets = append(duplicate.Assessments[0].LearningTargets, duplicate.Assessments[0].LearningTargets[0])
	if _, err := NormalizeDiagnosticAssessmentPlan(duplicate); !errors.Is(err, ErrValidation) {
		t.Fatalf("duplicate target accepted: %v", err)
	}
}

func TestDiagnosticPlanRejectsNoncanonicalPlannerTimestamps(t *testing.T) {
	for name, mutate := range map[string]func(*DiagnosticAssessmentPlan){
		"created offset": func(plan *DiagnosticAssessmentPlan) {
			plan.CreatedAt = plan.CreatedAt.In(time.FixedZone("offset", 3600))
		},
		"created nanos": func(plan *DiagnosticAssessmentPlan) { plan.CreatedAt = plan.CreatedAt.Add(time.Nanosecond) },
		"item offset": func(plan *DiagnosticAssessmentPlan) {
			plan.Assessments[0].UpdatedAt = plan.Assessments[0].UpdatedAt.In(time.FixedZone("offset", 3600))
		},
		"item nanos": func(plan *DiagnosticAssessmentPlan) {
			plan.Assessments[0].UpdatedAt = plan.Assessments[0].UpdatedAt.Add(time.Nanosecond)
		},
	} {
		t.Run(name, func(t *testing.T) {
			plan := diagnosticTestPlan(t, 3)
			mutate(&plan)
			plan.PlanDigest, _ = DiagnosticAssessmentPlanDigest(plan)
			if _, err := NormalizeDiagnosticAssessmentPlan(plan); !errors.Is(err, ErrValidation) {
				t.Fatalf("err=%v", err)
			}
		})
	}
}

func TestDiagnosticResultBandDigestAndBindingValidation(t *testing.T) {
	result := DiagnosticAssessmentResult{
		Schema: "student-diagnostic-assessment-result.v1", StudentID: "22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222", CourseID: "33333333-3333-4333-8333-333333333333",
		CourseContentRevision: "sha256:aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa", PolicyVersion: DiagnosticAssessmentPolicy,
		AttemptID: "66666666-6666-4666-8666-666666666666", PlanID: "11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111", PlanRevision: 2,
		Correct: 4, Total: 5, Percent: 80, Band: "ADVANCED", BandPolicyVersion: DiagnosticAssessmentBandPolicy,
		PlanDigest: "sha256:bbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbb", CompletedAt: time.Date(2026, 2, 1, 0, 0, 0, 123000000, time.UTC),
	}
	result.ResultDigest, _ = DiagnosticAssessmentResultDigest(result)
	normalized, err := NormalizeDiagnosticAssessmentResult(result)
	if err != nil || !normalized.CompletedAt.Equal(result.CompletedAt.UTC().Truncate(time.Microsecond)) {
		t.Fatalf("valid result rejected: %+v %v", normalized, err)
	}
	for name, mutate := range map[string]func(*DiagnosticAssessmentResult){
		"wrong band":    func(r *DiagnosticAssessmentResult) { r.Band = "CORE" },
		"wrong percent": func(r *DiagnosticAssessmentResult) { r.Percent = 79 },
		"wrong digest": func(r *DiagnosticAssessmentResult) {
			r.ResultDigest = "sha256:cccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccc"
		},
		"wrong policy":  func(r *DiagnosticAssessmentResult) { r.PolicyVersion = "other" },
		"wrong binding": func(r *DiagnosticAssessmentResult) { r.PlanID = "77777777-7777-4777-8777-777777777777" },
		"offset completed": func(r *DiagnosticAssessmentResult) {
			r.CompletedAt = r.CompletedAt.In(time.FixedZone("offset", 3600))
			r.ResultDigest, _ = DiagnosticAssessmentResultDigest(*r)
		},
		"nanos completed": func(r *DiagnosticAssessmentResult) {
			r.CompletedAt = r.CompletedAt.Add(time.Nanosecond)
			r.ResultDigest, _ = DiagnosticAssessmentResultDigest(*r)
		},
	} {
		copy := result
		mutate(&copy)
		if _, err := NormalizeDiagnosticAssessmentResult(copy); !errors.Is(err, ErrValidation) {
			t.Errorf("%s accepted: %v", name, err)
		}
	}
}
